scope: New non-contemporaneous fixed-pool replication. Controls collected after the original research; no original evidence or public case is replaced.
selectionRule: Retain every attempted response, failure and interruption. Trial one is the predeclared comparison; no repair or best-of selection.
limitations: The shared pool includes Qloo-discovered candidates; this tests selection, not discovery.
Artist fees and availability are illustrative.
No independent human judgments or ticket outcomes.
Policy points cannot prove superiority on their own objective.
